rumor_pool: The coal seam on Floor 15 has started making groaning sounds; feels like an old shaft might cave soon...
Old Bram reckons anyone with a heavy enough hammer to smash the Floor 25 amethyst boulder will find a lost dwarven coffer.
Silk and southern spice prices are skyrocketing in Solaria; Captain Garrick will be buying heavy loads of valley herbs next run.
Western pass snowfall hit earlier than usual; snow wolves are already prowling the pine fringes.
Ancient scrolls record that the stone altars beneath Oakhaven once cleansed celestial miasma for the entire valley.
Grandmother Amalia once possessed a fragment of an antique parchment leading to an enchanted glade deep in Whisperwood.

guest_types.quote: The howling gale freezes marrow... Bless you, hospitable tavernkeeper, for sheltering a wandering soul without prying.
The aroma of cedar smoke and boiling stew thawed the frostbite from my bones. Such honest shelter warrants a fair boon.
